description: The Search Stats REST API's total_queries_validation_error field states 'when the query request included a validate property in the ctl object' and links to search-request-params.html#validate - naming a 'validate' property of the ctl object that round 22's own search-request-params extraction (the origin record for search:ctl-object) does not mention anywhere in its concepts, relations, or notable_absence. Either the property was present on that page but not captured in round 22, or it lives at a separate anchor round 22's read did not surface - left open for reconciliation to check against the live page rather than guessed at.
